reconcileDrift: The typed interaction registry is now verified, but ProductionScreenDataManager snapshots still expose only legacy flat items. Existing persisted values, dynamic choices, facts and typed action descriptors therefore do not reach the Store/UI draft, so real user input cannot reliably prepare valid commands.
goal: Populate every production ScreenSnapshot with the verified ScreenContractRegistry fields, facts and actions, enriching drafts from the actual persisted entity/settings state and dynamic catalog/workspace choices while preserving authored user values. Ensure editor/detail/restore/privacy/notification commands can be prepared with valid typed arguments and stable subject IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: All sixteen ScreenId snapshots expose the registry fields, facts and actions; dynamic choice options use stable IDs plus TextKey or authored labels.
Existing zone, tray, recipe, batch, plan, observation, settings, privacy and notification values initialize editor drafts without localizing or rewriting authored user content.
Required dates/instants/defaults are deterministic and valid for registry command preparation; edit snapshots retain their stable subject IDs.
Backup/restore snapshots expose document identifiers and preview facts without interpreting opaque document identifiers as filesystem paths.

Integration tests prove representative create/edit/settings/privacy/restore snapshots can prepare commands accepted by ProductionScreenDataManager and that unknown/malformed commands remain non-mutating.
No Compose UI, platform, build, ledger or external service changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
